bullets.text: Highlight Reels for Xbox - Xbox Insiders can now try highlight reels in the Xbox PC app for ROG Xbox Ally X.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New Canary Channel build introduces voice typing in File Explorer and improved storage management.
AI Threat Landscape - Microsoft highlights how threat actors are operationalizing AI to enhance cyberattack strategies.
Women in Cybersecurity - Microsoft emphasizes the importance of diversity in cybersecurity during Women's History Month.
Malicious AI Extensions - Microsoft Defender warns of malicious browser extensions harvesting sensitive data from AI chats.
Copilot App Update - New feature allows Copilot to open web links in a sidepane, enhancing user experience.
OAuth Exploitation - Microsoft identifies phishing campaigns exploiting OAuth redirection mechanisms to deliver malware.
Instant Access Snapshots - Azure introduces instant access for incremental snapshots, enhancing data recovery speed.
